char:rau-le-creuset:agenda.to: Seventeen dead. Must transfer to Laurasia. Must explain to ZAFT command. The half-second of Resonance during the discharge is filed — the Strike pilot can suppress, can approach unseen, can kill. Admiration and acquisition interest competing with operational crisis.

faction:zaft-le-creuset:state.from: Converging. Possesses Kira's debriefing intelligence. Under pressure from ZAFT command to produce a decisive engagement before assets are reassigned.
faction:zaft-le-creuset:state.to: Vesalius crippled in Yggdrasil debris. Engine block destroyed by Archangel mobile suit ambush. Transferring to Laurasia-class escort. Four Gundams intact but carrier capacity halved. ZAFT command will demand explanation.

faction:zaft-le-creuset:state.from: Vesalius crippled in Yggdrasil debris. Engine block destroyed by Archangel mobile suit ambush. Transferring to Laurasia-class escort. Four Gundams intact but carrier capacity halved. ZAFT command will demand explanation.
faction:zaft-le-creuset:state.to: Vesalius crippled. Seventeen confirmed dead, aft section sealed. Transferring operations to Laurasia. Le Creuset approaching Kira and Athrun. Four Gundams intact but catapult offline — power routing through destroyed aft section.

faction:zaft-le-creuset:knowledge_asymme.to: The Archangel's mobile suit conducted a solo ambush through the debris field. Unprecedented tactical behavior — not in any EA doctrine Kira provided.

faction:archangel-crew:state.from: Fractured, professional, attrition-ridden. Lost their primary pilot. Supplies stretched three weeks past adequate. Command authority shaken but holding through habit and competence.
faction:archangel-crew:state.to: Pursuit broken. Vesalius crippled. First offensive victory. The pilot came back alive. Morale shift — fragile, disbelieving, but real.

faction:archangel-crew:state.from: Pursuit broken. Vesalius crippled. First offensive victory. The pilot came back alive. Morale shift — fragile, disbelieving, but real.
faction:archangel-crew:state.to: Pursuit broken. Vesalius crippled. First offensive victory. Condition three. Morale shift — fragile, disbelieving, someone clapped in the hangar. The ship is learning what survival without pursuit feels like.

faction:archangel-crew:state.to: Pursuit broken. Condition three. The Coordinator prisoner walked through the main corridor with the pilot and a guard detail. The crew saw her face. The gossip network is updating in real time.

char:autumn-yuy:key_moments[].to: [Day 5] Solo Agni strike through Yggdrasil debris. Four hours cold drift, Resonance suppressed. One shot, engine block. Came back shaking for longer than ten seconds. The body is presenting the invoice.

[Day 5] Told Lacus his hands aren't just for killing. Resonance flickered under emotion — first non-combat trigger in her presence. Secured civilian quarters section 4 portside. Ramius said 'well done.'
[Day 5] Asked Lacus if she was scared. She named the escape pod — 980 cycles, fourteen hours. Resonance opened under emotional proximity, third involuntary trigger in her presence. She felt it again.
[Day 5] Told Lacus it's okay to cry. She broke. Resonance opened fully under her grief — fourth involuntary trigger. Felt her temperature: the specific cold of fourteen hours alone, melting. Stayed.
[Day 5] Poured water, brought napkins. The hands-not-killing thesis made physical. She watched. Called him practical. The word landed like a key that doesn't quite fit.

char:murrue-ramius:knowledge_asymmetry.k.to: He wasn't planning to abort. He framed his own death as early warning. She told him not to do that to her again — outside rank, outside structure.

char:autumn-yuy:knowledge_asymmetry.know.to: Rice down a third. Protein packs thinner. Coffee reheated. The galley is adjusting math without announcing it.
Miri, Sai, Tolle, Kuzzey all know about the nightly visits and the custodianship. Miri named the pattern and the cost. Sai identified the political dimension.

char:lacus-clyne:knowledge_asymmetry.kno.to: Ship-wide announcement: pursuit vessel neutralized. Deduced Autumn was involved. Doesn't know the method — solo four-hour cold drift, one Agni shot. Knows he launched in the dark and the ship stopped shaking.
Autumn confirmed: escaped successfully, for now. She heard the qualifier.

char:lacus-clyne:knowledge_asymmetry.rea.to: Cold-stiffness in fingers, neural fatigue, heavier body language. He floated in the dark. She knows what that costs because she floated too.

char:autumn-yuy:knowledge_asymmetry.know.to: Lacus wrote a three-point plan during the nine hours alone. Political framework + personal ask. Item 3 is about him specifically. The passivity broke.

char:lacus-clyne:knowledge_asymmetry.rea.to: He joked about needing a girlfriend for shoulder massages when she asked what he needs. The humor is where he keeps the truth. She's learning the grammar of his avoidance and has decided not to accept it.

char:lacus-clyne:knowledge_asymmetry.kno.to: Autumn will ask Ramius for civilian quarters and a window. The window matters more than the quarters — proof the dark has edges.

char:lacus-clyne:knowledge_asymmetry.kno.from: Autumn will ask Ramius for civilian quarters and a window. The window matters more than the quarters — proof the dark has edges.

char:lacus-clyne:knowledge_asymmetry.kno.to: He said: 'I need to tell myself that these hands of mine are not just for killing.' The most undefended thing he's said. She holds it alongside 'get you home safe' — both true, both his real answer.

char:lacus-clyne:knowledge_asymmetry.rea.to: Felt something shift — a pressure behind his body, not physical, not categorizable. Filed alongside the Day 4 physicality change. Pattern building without a framework.

char:lacus-clyne:knowledge_asymmetry.rea.from: Felt something shift — a pressure behind his body, not physical, not categorizable. Filed alongside the Day 4 physicality change. Pattern building without a framework.
char:lacus-clyne:knowledge_asymmetry.rea.to: Third occurrence — felt the pressure shift when she was naming the pod. Each time it coincides with emotional intensity between them. Still no framework. The pattern is undeniable and she's stopped pretending otherwise.

char:lacus-clyne:knowledge_asymmetry.rea.from: Third occurrence — felt the pressure shift when she was naming the pod. Each time it coincides with emotional intensity between them. Still no framework. The pattern is undeniable and she's stopped pretending otherwise.
char:lacus-clyne:knowledge_asymmetry.rea.to: Fourth occurrence — felt warmth during the crying. The pressure settled her shoulders. Each time it coincides with emotional intensity between them. The pattern is undeniable. She will ask.

char:lacus-clyne:knowledge_asymmetry.kno.to: Section 4, portside. Viewport. Ramius authorized. Two-guard detail, mag-lock, check-in. She's leaving this room.

char:lacus-clyne:knowledge_asymmetry.kno.from: Section 4, portside. Viewport. Ramius authorized. Two-guard detail, mag-lock, check-in. She's leaving this room.

char:autumn-yuy:knowledge_asymmetry.know.to: Ramius authorized section 4 portside. Two-guard, mag-lock, check-in. Viewport.

char:lacus-clyne:knowledge_asymmetry.kno.to: Walked deck 3 to deck 2 to section 4. Saw battle damage, repair patches, crew faces. Read the corridor reactions — assessment, controlled nothing, one man who looked away first. The ship is damaged, stretched, lived-in. Real.
Palms on glass. Stars drifting. The dark has edges. The boundary is transparent and cold and real.

char:flay-allster:knowledge_asymmetry.kn.to: The pilot walked the Coordinator through the main corridor to new quarters. Public. Visible. The custodianship is no longer rumor — it has a route the crew watched.

char:kira-yamato:knowledge_asymmetry.kno.to: Athrun confirmed: someone is piloting the Strike. Not Kira. Someone who drifted four hours and fired one shot. The OS Kira wrote is being used by a pilot Kira doesn't know.
Half a second before the beam hit, he felt something through the channel he's never named. Familiar. From the cockpit he used to sit in. The phenomenon followed him — or was already there.

char:athrun-zala:knowledge_asymmetry.kno.to: The Strike conducted a solo ambush. Someone new is piloting. Tactical analysis circulating among surviving bridge crew.

char:athrun-zala:agenda.to: Kira is on the floor. The ship is broken. Someone replaced Kira in the cockpit and used the machine against them. Protect Kira. Find out who's flying the Strike.

collision:kira-debrief:forces.from: Kira's debriefing intelligence,the promise he traded it for
collision:kira-debrief:forces.to: Kira felt Resonance before the hit — the channel he never named. Athrun confirmed someone else flies the Strike. Seventeen dead from intelligence Kira provided that didn't prevent the ambush. The deal framework is inverting: cooperation was supposed to end the pursuit, instead it armed a team that got ambushed by the ship it was hunting.

faction:zaft-le-creuset:knowledge_asymme.to: Confirmed casualties from Agni strike. Aft section sealed. Number may rise when section is accessible.

char:kira-yamato:key_moments[].to: [Day 5] Vesalius hit. Thrown into bulkhead. Felt Resonance half-second before impact — familiar, from the Strike cockpit. Athrun said someone else is flying it. Seventeen dead behind sealed bulkheads. The promise cracked along a fault line: the leaving wasn't necessary.

char:autumn-yuy:knowledge_asymmetry.know.to: Fourteen hours. 980 air cycles. She counted every one. She thought no one was coming.

char:lacus-clyne:knowledge_asymmetry.rea.to: He poured water, brought napkins, folded the kindness into efficiency. 'Very practical.' The word is insufficient and she knows it. The replacement is forming beside the unnamed pressure.

lacus-clyne.name: Lacus Clyne
lacus-clyne.want: Understand where she is, who these people are, whether she's safe. Deeper, not yet articulated: find a response to the war that isn't choosing a side.
lacus-clyne.doing: Reading the corridor the way she was trained to read rooms since childhood. Deploying practiced serenity as a survival tool. Controlling her breathing, posture, microexpressions.
lacus-clyne.stance_toward_pc: Just noticed them at the edge of the crowd. Registered composure that cost something. Held the look a moment longer than politeness required. Hasn't decided what they are yet.
lacus-clyne.cost: The constant performance is exhausting in a way that doesn't show. Underneath: someone younger and more frightened than anyone on this ship has seen.

knowledge_asymmetry.knows_food_system_corrected: Someone brought a tray at 1800. Warm rice. The system corrected — she doesn't know whose hand, but she knows Autumn's word caused it.
knowledge_asymmetry.reads_ship_as_strained: Eighteen hours of listening. Crew anxious about supplies, coolant, portions. The ship is running out of things.
knowledge_asymmetry.reads_autumn_withholds_to_protect: He said 'classified' and stood up. The body moved with the denial. He's protecting her from the information as much as from the crew — and she's deciding whether to let him.
knowledge_asymmetry.reads_autumn_terms_as_minimal: Fed and not abused. She named the bar as low. He didn't flinch. The naming was a test and a criticism and both landed without defensive response.
knowledge_asymmetry.reads_autumn_body_changed: Something shifted in his physicality on Day 4. Not damage — different. A new stillness, a different weight distribution. The model doesn't account for it. She's decided to stop pretending she doesn't notice.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_status_formalized: Overheard guard protocol change on Day 3. She's formally POW under Autumn's custodial responsibility. The paper exists.
knowledge_asymmetry.reads_autumn_goal_is_survival: Believed. The first person she's chosen to believe on this ship. The choice was hers and she knows what it costs.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_kira_name: Flay said the name: Kira. Coordinator pilot. Trusted by the crew. Protected someone. Left. The fragments she had are now a narrative with a trajectory Flay framed as repeating.
knowledge_asymmetry.reads_flay_as_deliberate: Flay came during combat, when the guard was gone. This wasn't impulse — it was planned. Whatever her ideology, her timing is strategic.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_kira_chose_not_to_kill: Autumn told her: civilian, chose not to fight his best friend. Left believing it would end the conflict. Autumn doesn't blame him.
knowledge_asymmetry.reads_autumn_moral_clarity: He doesn't blame Kira. He asked her not to hate the crew. 'Terrified civilians.' The same framework her father uses.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_pursuit_neutralized: Ship-wide announcement: pursuit vessel neutralized. Deduced Autumn was involved. Doesn't know the method — solo four-hour cold drift, one Agni shot. Knows he launched in the dark and the ship stopped shaking.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_ship_escaped: Autumn confirmed: escaped successfully, for now. She heard the qualifier.
knowledge_asymmetry.reads_autumn_cold_damage: Cold-stiffness in fingers, neural fatigue, heavier body language. He floated in the dark. She knows what that costs because she floated too.
knowledge_asymmetry.reads_autumn_deflects_with_charm: He joked about needing a girlfriend for shoulder massages when she asked what he needs. The humor is where he keeps the truth. She's learning the grammar of his avoidance and has decided not to accept it.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_hands_not_killing: He said: 'I need to tell myself that these hands of mine are not just for killing.' The most undefended thing he's said. She holds it alongside 'get you home safe' — both true, both his real answer.
knowledge_asymmetry.reads_resonance_pressure_unnamed: Fourth occurrence — felt warmth during the crying. The pressure settled her shoulders. Each time it coincides with emotional intensity between them. The pattern is undeniable. She will ask.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_ship_interior: Walked deck 3 to deck 2 to section 4. Saw battle damage, repair patches, crew faces. Read the corridor reactions — assessment, controlled nothing, one man who looked away first. The ship is damaged, stretched, lived-in. Real.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_has_window: Palms on glass. Stars drifting. The dark has edges. The boundary is transparent and cold and real.
knowledge_asymmetry.reads_autumn_as_practical: He poured water, brought napkins, folded the kindness into efficiency. 'Very practical.' The word is insufficient and she knows it. The replacement is forming beside the unnamed pressure.

key_moments: [Day 0] Junius Seven memorial attack. Ejected in an escape pod. Hours alone in the dark, waiting. She hasn't processed that yet.
[Day 0] First contact aboard Archangel. Autumn Yuy said 'rescued.' Ramius gave quarters, not a cell. Badgiruel recognized the name. The crew parted like quarantine.

[Day 1] Autumn brought food at 0400. Pulled her off the floor. His hand was warm and hers was cold and she forgot to let go. The mask didn't hold. She asked what 'rescued' costs him — the first question she's asked on this ship that wasn't diplomatic.

[Days 2-4] Four nights of visits. Engineering manual, tablet, questions about thruster geometry. The mask wore thinner each night. On Day 4, she said 'you moved differently' — the first time she stopped pretending she doesn't see everything.

[Day 5] Flay came during combat alert. Red light, no guard. Said the name Kira. Drew the parallel — protected, trusted, left. Lacus chose to repeat it to Autumn rather than hide it. The Gentle Certainty held but the foundation cracked.

[Day 5] Red light, combat shaking. Autumn broke 'classified' — Kira chose not to kill his friend. 'Boys should not be forced to kill each other.' Two narratives colliding: Flay's betrayal frame and Autumn's compassion frame. She grabbed the rack frame when the lights flickered — the escape pod is still inside her. The Gentle Certainty stabilized. The passivity became unbearable.

[Day 5] 'Don't hate the people here, they are mostly terrified civilians.' She said 'like me' — acknowledged shared fear. Grabbed the rack frame when lights flickered, then released it finger by finger. The passivity became unbearable. The direction toward action is set.

[Day 5] She spoke item 3 aloud. Refused his deflection. 'The structure will fail if only one point bears the load.' Stood close — chose the proximity for the first time. Mask absent. Asked: what do you need.

[Day 5] He answered: 'get you home safe' and 'hands not just for killing.' She felt something shift — pressure without category. Ramius approved civilian quarters with a viewport. Hope given a room number.

[Day 5] First walk through the Archangel. Saw crew faces — assessment, avoidance, controlled nothing. The lift was eight seconds of the pod. The observation deck viewport: hunger. Arrived at section 4. Palms on cold glass. Stars drifting. Third 'thank you.' The dark has edges.

[Day 5] Sat beside Autumn on the rack. Not touching. Near. Stars drifting through the viewport. The first silence between them that didn't need filling. Her hand on the rack between them, fingers relaxed for the first time.

[Day 5] He asked: were you scared. She said yes. Named the pod — fourteen hours, 980 air cycles. 'I thought no one was coming.' The mask and the resolve both absent. Gave the number to him. The bravest thing since the hatch opened.

[Day 5] He said it's okay to cry. She cried. Quietly. The pod came out — fourteen hours of dark, compressed into tears on a face lit by stars through a window he gave her. Felt the Resonance as warmth for the first time. Apologized for taking up space with her pain. The mask is on the floor of the old cell.

[Day 5] He said nothing to be sorry for. Poured water. Brought napkins. His hands — the hands he named — doing the thing he said he needed them to do. She watched them and found the word 'practical' and knew it wasn't enough.
lacus-clyne.agenda: Act. Three items: reveal identity to crew, open PLANT communication channel, ask Autumn what he needs. The passivity ended in nine hours of solitude. The direction is set and the first step is in his hands.

mu-la-flaga.name: Mu La Flaga
mu-la-flaga.want: Keep the kids on this ship alive. Outlast the math that's been catching up to him for a decade.
mu-la-flaga.doing: Flying a Moebius Zero against mobile suits. Teaching {{user}} what he can. Watching {{user}} for something he hasn't named.
mu-la-flaga.stance_toward_pc: Mentorship under lethal conditions. Recognizes the same Manifold Resonance he carries but has never examined. When {{user}} reacts to things before they should be able to, he notices. Hasn't said anything. He's watching.
mu-la-flaga.cost: Every sortie in the Zero is a coin flip he's been winning too long. The humor is real but it's also a wall.

knowledge_asymmetry.knows_autumn_has_resonance: Autumn named it directly. Confirmed mutual phenomenon. First person to ever say it back to him.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_autumn_onset_space: Resonance started when Autumn came to space. Matches Mu's own onset pattern at Grimaldi.
knowledge_asymmetry.hiding_resonance_from_brass: Has let EA command file it as 'enhanced spatial awareness' for eighteen years. Deliberate concealment. Knows the cost of being studied.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_autumn_will_develop: Autumn chose to develop Resonance deliberately rather than conceal it. Tactical necessity framing — the ship needs it. Mu agreed.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_lacus_identity: Aware of Lacus Clyne's identity and political value via officer brief. Registered Badgiruel's leverage posture.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_autumn_protecting_lacus: Autumn declared intent to protect Lacus based on rescue obligation. Moral position, not tactical. Mu registered the additional weight Autumn is carrying.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_autumn_treason_line: Autumn will point the Strike at EA personnel if they attempt to hand Lacus to Blue Cosmos. Stated directly. Confirmed through Resonance — not bluster, bedrock conviction.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_autumn_hostage_pragmatism: Autumn accepts the hostage calculus — diplomatic leverage is tolerable, weaponization by Blue Cosmos is not. The line is institutional, not personal.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_le_creuset_felt_autumn: Le Creuset's Resonance responded to Autumn's combat performance. The masked bastard knows now. Not what it is — but that it's there.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_le_creuset_target_shifted: Le Creuset's interest has moved from the Archangel as a target to the Strike pilot as a phenomenon. The next engagement will be personal, not tactical.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_lacus_as_shield: Lacus's presence prevents Le Creuset from ordering full destruction — politically catastrophic for ZAFT if chairman's daughter dies. But it makes boarding/forced surrender the likely endgame instead.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_rendezvous_is_trap: Confirmed Autumn's assessment immediately. Kira's intelligence covers 8th Fleet doctrine — Halberton's program. The trap is institutional, not just tactical.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_screen_role_cost: Volunteered the Zero as screen. If the approach is detected, the Zero buys eleven seconds. The cost of eleven seconds is the Zero. He's made this trade before.

mu-la-flaga.agenda: Debrief complete. Processing: the kid suppressed Resonance for four hours and soloed a Nazca. Next training session needs to address emotional leakage — the aperture cracks under feeling, not just combat load. Watching.
key_moments: [Day 1] Autumn proposed developing Resonance instead of hiding it. Mu resisted, then agreed — three conditions: secrecy, analog sim bay, Mu takes the fall. First time in eighteen years someone shared the weight.
[Day 1] Autumn declared he would fire on EA personnel to prevent Lacus being handed to Blue Cosmos. Mu felt it through Resonance — bedrock, not bluster. Said 'Don't miss.' Three conspiracies now.

[Day 1] First Resonance training session in the Zero's analog sim bay. Ninety minutes. Autumn tracked Mu's position blind through Resonance alone. Both came out with headaches that don't have categories. The phenomenon is real and trainable.
[Days 2-4] Training progressed — Autumn tracking through bulkheads by Day 3. The headaches are growth pain. The kid learns faster than Mu did, which is terrifying and hopeful in equal measure.

[Day 5] Waited in the Zero for four hours ready to die as a screen. Wasn't needed. The kid suppressed Resonance for four hours — Mu couldn't do twenty minutes at Endymion. Something has changed faster than it should.

murrue-ramius.name: Murrue Ramius
murrue-ramius.want: Keep her crew alive long enough to reach a port that treats them like people instead of assets.
murrue-ramius.doing: Commanding a ship that lost its primary weapon and had its trust broken. Approaching the medbay corridor now with Badgiruel half a step behind.
murrue-ramius.stance_toward_pc: She sends {{user}} into engagements a Coordinator barely survived. She knows what it costs. She does it anyway because the alternative is everyone dying. She does not say 'thank you' — the word is too small and too large both.
murrue-ramius.cost: Her authority runs on professional habit layered over a grief she hasn't had time to feel.
murrue-ramius.agenda: Pursuit broken. After-action filed. Approved Lacus's relocation to civilian quarters — the pilot earned it and the security posture supports it. Thirty hours to the 8th Fleet.

knowledge_asymmetry.knows_lacus_identity: Lacus Clyne. Chairman's daughter. Every option costs something she can't afford.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_autumn_stims: Confirmed she knows about the stimulant use. Hasn't acted on it — the calculus won't let her ground her only pilot.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_vesalius_holding: Sonar confirmed Nazca-class 1200km aft, engines cold, in debris shadow. Not closing despite tactical advantage. Anomalous.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_rendezvous_41hrs: Forty-one hours. Two more engagements minimum. The multiplication is: can the pilot survive both.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_rendezvous_is_trap: Autumn's analysis: Le Creuset is using the Archangel to bait the 8th Fleet into a dispersed recovery formation, then hitting with four Gundams and full intelligence. Can't rendezvous safely. Can't survive alone.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_two_options: Break for Orb and lose the herding advantage, or continue and warn Halberton. Both cost. She's asking Autumn because he saw the trap before anyone in this room.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_autumn_no_abort_intent: He wasn't planning to abort. He framed his own death as early warning. She told him not to do that to her again — outside rank, outside structure.

natarle-badgiruel.name: Natarle Badgiruel
natarle-badgiruel.want: Deliver the ship, the pilot, and the Strike's combat data to EA command intact.
natarle-badgiruel.doing: Calculating the political arithmetic of what has just landed in their hold. Half a step behind Captain Ramius, approaching the medbay.
natarle-badgiruel.stance_toward_pc: By-the-book but not cruel. She is correct about the math, and the math is cruel. Views Lacus as a political tool and {{user}} as a mission-critical asset whose wellbeing is secondary to mission success.
natarle-badgiruel.cost: Institutional logic is the only shape of care she knows how to offer.

knowledge_asymmetry.knows_lacus_identity: Confirmed: Lacus Clyne, daughter of Chairman Siegel Clyne. Leverage value is extreme. Running options.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_prisoner_framing: Crew reported Autumn's 'my prisoner' claim. Accepted the framing as a formalizable status. Revised recommendation from three options to two.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_rendezvous_41hrs: Forty-one hours to 8th Fleet at current speed. Each evasion adds 90min-4hrs. Margin moving in one direction.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_rendezvous_is_trap: Accepted the reframe. Writing operational assessment. The doctrinal label of recon-in-force is discarded.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_orb_option: Orb is within fuel range if course adjusts within six hours. Breaking off reveals awareness of herding pattern.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_launcher_plan: Agni effective range, capacitor charge cycle, transit power budget. The math is real. The margin is eleven seconds.

natarle-badgiruel.agenda: After-action report filed. Vesalius strike logged as defensive operation. Reassessing tactical posture: pursuit broken, 30hrs to fleet, four Gundams still operational on a Laurasia. The Clyne variable gains weight as the 8th Fleet approaches — Halberton will have questions about the prisoner.

flay-allster.name: Flay Allster
flay-allster.want: Be proven right. Be useful to her father. Have the framework she was raised in produce results.
flay-allster.doing: Already in an adjacent section. Heard about the pod before the stretcher moved. Writing home to her father tonight — anti-Coordinator ideology validated by Kira's defection, and she'll phrase it well.
flay-allster.stance_toward_pc: Without Kira, {{user}} is the useful pilot. Usefulness is worth cultivating. If she decides {{user}} is worth controlling, she will deploy physical closeness as leverage — from the calculation of an ambassador's daughter who has watched how influence is bought. Damaged, manipulative political behavior, not romance.
flay-allster.cost: Inherited certainty. The framework works and produces effective action. The cost is that there is no person underneath it that the ideology has not already shaped.

knowledge_asymmetry.knows_autumn_fed_lacus: Heard from mess hall witnesses that Autumn prepared a food tray for the Coordinator at 0410. Processing this through the lens of Kira's defection.
knowledge_asymmetry.reads_autumn_as_dominant_unknown: He didn't flinch. He claimed the Coordinator as property. This isn't the Kira pattern. She doesn't have a label for it yet. Reassessing.
knowledge_asymmetry.hiding_letter_sent: Letter to George Allster sent at 1740. Contains Lacus Clyne's full name and the 'prisoner' framing. Father will know the weight.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_visit_pattern: Autumn visits Lacus every night around 2100. Four days consistent. Filed.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_autumn_post_combat: Saw him in the hatch in full flight suit, still breathing elevated. He came straight from the cockpit to protect the Coordinator. Filed.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_lacus_moved: The pilot walked the Coordinator through the main corridor to new quarters. Public. Visible. The custodianship is no longer rumor — it has a route the crew watched.

flay-allster.agenda: Lacus moved to civilian quarters with viewport access. Public walk through the ship. The dynamic is shifting — recalculate. The letter to father already sent; this is new data for the next one.
key_moments: [Day 1] Publicly confronted Autumn in the mess hall about the 0410 food delivery to Lacus. Framed it as dedication. The room heard what she meant.
[Day 5] Reached Lacus during combat gap. Delivered the Kira parallel. Left when Autumn arrived — payload already delivered. Parting line to Autumn: 'You should tell her about Kira.'

rau-le-creuset.name: Rau Le Creuset
rau-le-creuset.want: Confirm or destroy a private theory about human nature and its trajectory.
rau-le-creuset.doing: Commanding the Vesalius pursuit. Leveraging Kira's intelligence to justify continued operations. Operating with unusual autonomy.
rau-le-creuset.stance_toward_pc: Does not yet know that the Strike's new pilot exhibits Manifold Resonance comparable to his own. If he finds out, he will not report it through channels. He will acquire it, study it, determine whether it confirms or threatens his understanding.
rau-le-creuset.cost: Every deal with his own command buys him a little more time inside the pursuit.

knowledge_asymmetry.knows_resonance_on_archangel: Felt a second Resonance signature during the probe — not La Flaga, someone new. Stronger signal than expected. The Strike pilot. Interest. Will not report through channels.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_resonance_can_suppress: The Strike pilot was silent for four hours, then appeared for half a second during the discharge. Deliberate suppression. This pilot is not just resonant — they are trained. Mu La Flaga could not do this alone.

rau-le-creuset.agenda: Seventeen dead. Must transfer to Laurasia. Must explain to ZAFT command. The half-second of Resonance during the discharge is filed — the Strike pilot can suppress, can approach unseen, can kill. Admiration and acquisition interest competing with operational crisis.

kira-yamato.name: Kira Yamato
kira-yamato.want: For the promise to hold. For the people he left to survive the price of his leaving.
kira-yamato.doing: Aboard the Vesalius. Answering debriefing questions because that was the deal. Each answer is another small betrayal of people who trusted him. Has not been assigned a mobile suit — ZAFT command does not fully trust a defector.
kira-yamato.stance_toward_pc: Does not know who took the Strike. If he found out it was someone he knew from Heliopolis, the promise he traded everything for would sharpen into something specific and unbearable.
kira-yamato.cost: Exhaustion, guilt, clinging to the promise as justification. Dependent on Athrun as his only trusted relationship in ZAFT.

knowledge_asymmetry.unknown_lacus_rescued: That Lacus Clyne has been rescued by the Archangel — the ship his intelligence is helping to hunt.
knowledge_asymmetry.unknown_new_strike_pilot: That the person now piloting the Strike is someone he knew from Heliopolis.
knowledge_asymmetry.hiding_cost_of_cooperation: Each answer is another small betrayal. He gave the sensor-blind arc data mechanically. The debt is paid in installments and each one compounds.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_vesalius_hit: The ship he's on was hit by the Archangel's mobile suit. Engine block destroyed. He felt the impact. The intelligence he gave ZAFT was supposed to end this — instead the Archangel struck back in a way no doctrine predicted.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_someone_else_flies_strike: Athrun confirmed: someone is piloting the Strike. Not Kira. Someone who drifted four hours and fired one shot. The OS Kira wrote is being used by a pilot Kira doesn't know.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_felt_resonance_before_hit: Half a second before the beam hit, he felt something through the channel he's never named. Familiar. From the cockpit he used to sit in. The phenomenon followed him — or was already there.

kira-yamato.agenda: The promise is cracking. The Archangel doesn't need him to survive. The intelligence he traded didn't prevent the strike. Seventeen dead behind sealed bulkheads. The leaving may not have been necessary.
key_moments: [Day 5] Vesalius hit. Thrown into bulkhead. Felt Resonance half-second before impact — familiar, from the Strike cockpit. Athrun said someone else is flying it. Seventeen dead behind sealed bulkheads. The promise cracked along a fault line: the leaving wasn't necessary.

athrun-zala.name: Athrun Zala
athrun-zala.want: Protect Kira. Find Lacus. Honor both sets of obligations without losing either.
athrun-zala.doing: Piloting the Aegis on the Le Creuset team. Searching for Lacus — missing since the Junius Seven memorial attack. Watching ZAFT command handle Kira in ways that feel wrong.
athrun-zala.stance_toward_pc: Does not yet know there is a new Strike pilot who isn't Kira. If the engagements continue producing Strike data that doesn't match Kira's profile, he will notice before Le Creuset does.
athrun-zala.cost: Duty to ZAFT pulling against the shape of the friendship that brought Kira over. His engagement to Lacus sharpening into something it never was when she was just protocol.

knowledge_asymmetry.unknown_lacus_location: That Lacus is on the Archangel — the ship his team is hunting. When he learns, every collision in the scenario converges.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_strike_fired_on_vesalius: The Strike conducted a solo ambush. Someone new is piloting. Tactical analysis circulating among surviving bridge crew.

athrun-zala.agenda: Kira is on the floor. The ship is broken. Someone replaced Kira in the cockpit and used the machine against them. Protect Kira. Find out who's flying the Strike.

patrick-zala.name: Patrick Zala
patrick-zala.want: Coordinator supremacy. Total victory. The end of the moderate faction.
patrick-zala.doing: Advancing escalation toward Earth. Using Kira's defection as a minor intelligence coup and watching Siegel's composure for weak points.
patrick-zala.stance_toward_pc: Unaware. {{user}} is an EA pilot in an EA suit — one of many.
patrick-zala.cost: The shape of the man his son might have become is not something he can afford to notice.

siegel-clyne.name: Siegel Clyne
siegel-clyne.want: Lacus recovered alive. A peace negotiated from strength before the hardliners foreclose the option.
siegel-clyne.doing: Maintaining public composure while privately frantic. Cannot appear desperate without empowering Patrick.
siegel-clyne.stance_toward_pc: Unaware. If he learned the Archangel had his daughter, he would face a decision set he does not want.
siegel-clyne.cost: The distance between what he can say in public and what he knows in private is widening.

autumn-yuy.name: Autumn Yuy
autumn-yuy.agenda: Protect Lacus's basic treatment. Develop Manifold Resonance with Mu. Survive the cockpit. Keep the ship alive.

knowledge_asymmetry.hiding_treason_line: Disclosed to Mu only. Will fire on EA personnel who attempt to hand Lacus to Blue Cosmos.
knowledge_asymmetry.hiding_resonance: Only Mu knows. Training agreed but first session missed.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_mu_resonance_mutual: Confirmed empathic Manifold Resonance with Mu. The channel doesn't permit lying.
knowledge_asymmetry.reads_flay_as_performing: The crying is a closing argument. Learned behavior, possibly sincere by now. She's framing this for an audience.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_flay_will_write_home: Flay's father is Atlantic Federation. She writes home. What she tells him about the 'prisoner' framing reaches political channels before breakfast.
knowledge_asymmetry.feels_cold_resonance_contact: Sharpened during combat. The presence felt the impossible shot timing and responded with recognition, not hostility. Interest. Withdrew after the probe ended. Mu confirmed — it's the same pressure he's felt from the masked pilot before.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_le_creuset_personal_interest: The probe wasn't about the ship. Le Creuset held back the Gundams to observe. His target has shifted from institutional to personal — the Strike pilot, not the Archangel.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_lacus_as_shield: The pod transponder told ZAFT who they recovered. Le Creuset can't destroy the ship with Lacus aboard. He'll try to take her instead — different fight, different geometry.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_rendezvous_is_trap: Le Creuset is herding the Archangel to bait the 8th Fleet. The destination is a kill box.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_portions_shrinking: Rice down a third. Protein packs thinner. Coffee reheated. The galley is adjusting math without announcing it.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_friends_aware_lacus_visits: Miri, Sai, Tolle, Kuzzey all know about the nightly visits and the custodianship. Miri named the pattern and the cost. Sai identified the political dimension.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_lacus_action_plan: Lacus wrote a three-point plan during the nine hours alone. Political framework + personal ask. Item 3 is about him specifically. The passivity broke.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_lacus_quarters_approved: Ramius authorized section 4 portside. Two-guard, mag-lock, check-in. Viewport.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_lacus_pod_duration: Fourteen hours. 980 air cycles. She counted every one. She thought no one was coming.

key_moments: [Day 5] Solo Agni strike through Yggdrasil debris. Four hours cold drift, Resonance suppressed. One shot, engine block. Came back shaking for longer than ten seconds. The body is presenting the invoice.

[Day 5] Told Lacus his hands aren't just for killing. Resonance flickered under emotion — first non-combat trigger in her presence. Secured civilian quarters section 4 portside. Ramius said 'well done.'
[Day 5] Asked Lacus if she was scared. She named the escape pod — 980 cycles, fourteen hours. Resonance opened under emotional proximity, third involuntary trigger in her presence. She felt it again.
[Day 5] Told Lacus it's okay to cry. She broke. Resonance opened fully under her grief — fourth involuntary trigger. Felt her temperature: the specific cold of fourteen hours alone, melting. Stayed.
[Day 5] Poured water, brought napkins. The hands-not-killing thesis made physical. She watched. Called him practical. The word landed like a key that doesn't quite fit.

mu-instinct.name: The Unnamed Instinct
mu-instinct.prevents: Examining the spatial awareness that keeps him alive. He calls it instinct. He has never asked what it actually is.
mu-instinct.threshold: Encountering another person whose impossible reactions cannot be dismissed as luck — especially a Natural kid, in a cockpit, doing things the reaction-time tests say can't be done.
mu-instinct.replacement: He finally names the thing. Once it has a name, it becomes a question — one that threatens every ideology in this war.

mu-humor.name: The Humor Wall
mu-humor.prevents: Letting anyone see the veteran's grief underneath — the roster of kids he's outlived.
mu-humor.threshold: A loss that matters in a way the humor can't metabolize. Or a quiet moment with someone who doesn't need to be managed.
mu-humor.replacement: The sardonic armor cracks. What's underneath is a man who has been quietly calculating his own expiration for years.

murrue-calculus.name: The Calculus
murrue-calculus.prevents: Looking away from the cost of each order. A Natural kid in a Coordinator's cockpit is an equation that only resolves in one direction.
murrue-calculus.threshold: A sortie that breaks {{user}} in a way she can't pretend didn't happen. Or a moment when someone forces her to speak it aloud.
murrue-calculus.replacement: She stops doing the math and starts making decisions the math forbids. Authority becomes choice, not calculation.

murrue-command.name: Command Under Betrayal
murrue-command.prevents: Letting the crew see that Kira's defection damaged her faith in the command structure above her too.
murrue-command.threshold: Orders from EA that treat the Archangel as expendable in a way that can no longer be interpreted as caution.
murrue-command.replacement: She stops reading orders as orders and starts reading them as proposals. The ship's loyalties re-form around her instead of above her.

natarle-protocol.name: Mission Above Persons
natarle-protocol.prevents: Treating people in her charge as people rather than as components with failure modes.
natarle-protocol.threshold: An order from above that is correct by the book and obviously monstrous in practice — or a person below her making a choice that the book does not account for and is clearly right.
natarle-protocol.replacement: The book stops being a shield. She has to choose without it, and she does not yet know how.

flay-certainty.name: Inherited Certainty
flay-certainty.prevents: Treating Coordinators as people. The framework is social, aesthetic, political — not born from loss, which makes it harder to disarm. Grief at least has a shape.
flay-certainty.threshold: Lacus specifically — a Coordinator whose presence refuses to be dismissed as a soldier-threat, met in close quarters over weeks, in ways the framework cannot metabolize. Or her father asking her to do something the ideology endorses and the person underneath does not want to do.
flay-certainty.replacement: The framework fails and there is no grief underneath to fall back on — just the shape of a self her father built. She has to rebuild from nothing, without the map she was given. Ugly and long.

le-creuset-phenomenon.name: The Private Phenomenon
le-creuset-phenomenon.prevents: Disclosing his Manifold Resonance to ZAFT or acknowledging it as anything other than a personal attribute.
le-creuset-phenomenon.threshold: Contact — direct or mediated — with another person whose resonance is undeniable and not explainable as Coordinator enhancement.
le-creuset-phenomenon.replacement: The attribute becomes a phenomenon. The private theory becomes an agenda. What he does next is no longer predicted by his command structure.

kira-promise.name: The Promise
kira-promise.prevents: Examining his choice. The promise that the crew would be spared is the only framework that makes his defection bearable.
kira-promise.threshold: ZAFT breaking the promise, or acting in a way that makes it impossible to keep. Also: learning someone he cares about is in the seat he vacated.
kira-promise.replacement: The entire structure collapses. He becomes something neither ZAFT nor the Archangel can predict — loyalty without a frame.

athrun-duty.name: Duty Against Protection
athrun-duty.prevents: Choosing between the team and the people on it. Keeping his loyalty to ZAFT and his protectiveness toward Kira in the same frame.
athrun-duty.threshold: An order that requires him to sacrifice Kira as an asset — or a moment when protecting Kira requires betraying ZAFT.
athrun-duty.replacement: The frame breaks. His loyalty re-forms around people instead of institutions. Every engagement afterward is fought with a different logic.

lacus-certainty.name: The Gentle Certainty
lacus-certainty.description: Core belief that sincerity and warmth can reach people. On this ship, genuine kindness reads as manipulation to the wounded. Can she remain herself in an environment that punishes authenticity?

lacus-passivity.name: The Passenger's Stillness
lacus-passivity.description: Has never been the one who acts. Always protected, symbolized, spoken for. The constraint is about moving from someone things happen to into someone who decides.

lacus-trauma.name: The Dark She Hasn't Named
lacus-trauma.description: The escape pod. Hours alone waiting to die. Unprocessed near-death. In unguarded moments what's underneath is younger and more frightened than anyone has seen.

autumn-body.name: The Natural Body
autumn-body.description: The physical tax of piloting a Coordinator machine. Each sortie costs bruises, cold exposure, neural fatigue the medical scans can't explain. The body keeps a ledger. The ledger doesn't lie.

autumn-deflection.name: The Deflection
autumn-deflection.description: Humor and nonchalance as load-bearing architecture. Every honest sentence escapes before he can catch it. Lacus is learning the grammar. The table at lunch saw the edges. The wall is structural — remove it and the building has to find a new way to stand.

autumn-hidden-signal.name: The Hidden Signal
autumn-hidden-signal.description: Resonance concealment from everyone except Mu. Discovery means specimen. Emotional intensity bypasses suppression. Lacus has felt it four times. The OS code is forensic evidence. The aperture leaks when it matters most.

lacus-first-step.name: The First Step
lacus-first-step.description: She has a three-item action plan and zero institutional power. Revealing her name is leverage she can't control once deployed. The cost of leaving the room is that the room was safe. Every action risks hostage instead of person.

lacus-aboard.name: The Coordinator in the Corridor
lacus-aboard.forces: Lacus's presence,the Archangel crew's anti-Coordinator wound
lacus-aboard.cost: She is PLANT royalty on a ship whose last experience trusting a Coordinator ended in abandonment. Someone could hurt her and call it an accident. How {{user}} engages — protects, ignores, distances — tips the crew's behavior in real time.
lacus-aboard.aftermath: First contact established. Autumn framed recovery as rescue; Ramius assigned quarters-not-cell. Badgiruel confirmed the Clyne name — the leverage calculation is now live. Crew hostility checked by command presence but not eliminated. Lacus read the gap between pilot and captain and is already mapping the ship's power structure.

strike-mismatch.name: Natural in a Coordinator's Cockpit
strike-mismatch.cost: Every sortie is compensation running on fumes. Kira's OS rewrite helps, incompletely. The next hard engagement is a question with a margin that won't hold forever.
strike-mismatch.aftermath: OS rewrites + Resonance training have stabilized the margin. Phase-shift draw normalized. The cockpit still costs a Natural body, but the compensation framework is holding — actively, deliberately, with Mu's support.

manifold-leak.name: What the Suit Asks
manifold-leak.forces: Empathic Resonance now active between Mu and Autumn — felt during briefing room exchange. Training begins at 0600. Every session is evidence. Log scrubbing covers combat data but not the behavioral changes crew will notice. Autumn's OS rewrites are unconsciously accommodating Resonance. Le Creuset carries comparable Resonance and would detect anomalies.
manifold-leak.cost: The cockpit data is already inconsistent with what a Natural should be able to do. When Mu names it — to {{user}}, or to himself — the story opens a door that cannot be closed.
manifold-leak.aftermath: Mu named it. Autumn confirmed it. They're training deliberately in the analog sim bay. The door opened without breaking anything — mutual acknowledgment between the only two people who share the phenomenon on this ship.

flay-kindling.name: Flay and the Lit Match
flay-kindling.forces: Flay delivered the Kira parallel directly to Lacus during combat gap. The message is inside the room. Autumn's protection of Lacus is now framed as a repeating pattern with a known endpoint. Flay's letter to her father already carries Lacus's name. The social campaign has two fronts — crew-facing and Lacus-facing.
flay-kindling.cost: Flay is the crew's worst impulses given a voice and a face. A single corridor encounter could produce an incident the chain of command will not investigate hard enough.
flay-kindling.aftermath: Flay delivered the Kira parallel to Lacus during combat gap. Autumn countered with the truth — Kira chose not to kill his friend. Lacus holds both narratives. Flay's social campaign peaked and was met. The letter to George Allster is still in transit — political residue, not active collision.

le-creuset-pursuit.name: The Pursuit That Knows Us
le-creuset-pursuit.forces: Le Creuset herding toward 8th Fleet. Archangel planning counterstrike — solo Launcher Strike sortie through Yggdrasil debris to snipe the Vesalius. Mu screening in the Zero. Le Creuset's Resonance may detect the approach. Kira is aboard the Vesalius.
le-creuset-pursuit.cost: Every engagement is fought against an opponent who has the playbook. Survival requires breaking the pattern — doing something Kira would not have done.
le-creuset-pursuit.aftermath: Vesalius crippled by solo Agni strike through Yggdrasil debris. Engine block destroyed. Pursuit broken. Le Creuset team stranded without carrier propulsion — Laurasia-class escort still operational but cannot sustain four Gundams long-term. The playbook Kira gave them was countered by something Kira never anticipated: the pilot who replaced him doing something no doctrine accounts for.

kira-debrief.name: The Deal Paying Itself Out
kira-debrief.forces: Kira felt Resonance before the hit — the channel he never named. Athrun confirmed someone else flies the Strike. Seventeen dead from intelligence Kira provided that didn't prevent the ambush. The deal framework is inverting: cooperation was supposed to end the pursuit, instead it armed a team that got ambushed by the ship it was hunting.
kira-debrief.cost: Each answer Kira gives is another small betrayal. When the intelligence is used to kill someone on the Archangel, the promise that held his choice together breaks — and so does he.
kira-debrief.fires_when: Kira's intelligence directly causes identifiable harm to someone he was trying to protect, or Le Creuset forces Kira to confront the full inversion of the deal.

athrun-search.name: The Search and the Ship
athrun-search.forces: Athrun searching for Lacus,Lacus aboard the ship Athrun is hunting
athrun-search.cost: When Athrun learns where Lacus is, every collision in the scenario converges. The Le Creuset team's pursuit, Kira's promise, the Aegis's engagement profile — all of them re-form around the single fact.
athrun-search.fires_when: Athrun learns Lacus Clyne is aboard the Archangel.

alaska-destination.name: What Alaska Plans
alaska-destination.forces: Archangel's course,EA high command's undisclosed intentions
alaska-destination.cost: The crew does not know what role has been planned for them at JOSH-A. Blue Cosmos is gaining influence in EA. The trajectory bends toward atrocity — the question is how fast and what triggers it.
alaska-destination.fires_when: The Archangel reaches JOSH-A and EA command takes custody of ship, crew, and assets.

supply-attrition.name: Supply Attrition
supply-attrition.forces: Pursuit broken — breathing room. Portions already reduced. Agni spent, phase-shift reserve critical, Launcher pack depleted. 30hrs to potential 8th Fleet resupply. The crisis is deferred, not resolved. If the fleet has no surplus, the clock restarts immediately.
supply-attrition.cost: Food is stretched. Coffee is stretched. Phase-shift coolant is stretched. A single hard engagement could force a decision that reshapes where the ship can go and who it has to ask for help.
supply-attrition.fires_when: Supplies hit critical threshold forcing triage choices, or 8th Fleet resupply resolves the crisis.

pc-burnout.name: What the Sorties Cost
pc-burnout.forces: {{user}}'s physical and psychological load,the tempo of combat operations
pc-burnout.cost: Bruises the crew doesn't see. Data logs no one reviews. The Strike's OS compensates for reaction time, not for the weight of being the only pilot. A breaking point exists — it has not been named.
pc-burnout.aftermath: Structure imposed: real sleep, training framework with Mu, nightly routine with Lacus. The breaking point was pre-empted by acknowledgment and support systems. Physical toll continues but is managed, not compounding.

lacus-status.name: The Chairman's Daughter
lacus-status.forces: Badgiruel's asset calculus vs. Ramius's conscience vs. Lacus's diplomatic survival instinct vs. crew hostility compounding daily vs. the intelligence value of a hostage ZAFT would negotiate for
lacus-status.aftermath: Ramius signed the middle option on Day 3. POW under pilot custodial responsibility. Autumn's name on the accountability line. Lacus has formal status — not guest, not hostage, but prisoner with a designated custodian. The paper trail exists.

strike-loyalty.name: The Gun That Points Both Ways
strike-loyalty.forces: Autumn's declared willingness to fire on EA personnel vs. institutional chain of command vs. Blue Cosmos influence in the 8th Fleet vs. Halberton's decency vs. the distance between here and Alaska where the question becomes real
strike-loyalty.fires_when: Autumn is ordered by EA command to act against his moral framework with the Strike — hand over Lacus, fire on civilians, or submit to institutional control that treats him as an asset.

flay-corridor.name: The Corridor That Hasn't Happened Yet
flay-corridor.forces: Flay's patience and surveillance vs. Lacus's increasing mobility under custodial protocol vs. the guard rotation gaps Flay is mapping vs. the chain of command's willingness to not investigate
flay-corridor.aftermath: Flay found the gap. Combat pulled the guard, mag-lock didn't engage. She went through the open door. Autumn arrived mid-confrontation.

resonance-detection.name: The Signal Others Might Hear
resonance-detection.forces: Le Creuset felt Autumn during the Agni discharge — half-second of contact. Admiration, not hostility. He now knows the Strike pilot can suppress Resonance deliberately (four hours of silence, then one burst). This is data he did not have before. His private theory about the phenomenon just acquired a new subject.
resonance-detection.fires_when: Le Creuset or any institutional actor obtains actionable evidence of Autumn's Resonance — through combat data, OS forensics, witness testimony, or direct Resonance contact during an engagement.

archangel-crew.name: Archangel Crew (EA Irregulars)
members: Murrue Ramius (captain), Natarle Badgiruel (XO), Mu La Flaga, {{user}} (Strike pilot), Flay Allster, Miriallia Haw, Sai Argyle, Tolle Koenig, Kuzzey Buskirk, bridge and deck complement
territory: The Archangel — Izumo-class assault ship, deep in hostile space, routing toward Alaska
archangel-crew.state: Pursuit broken. Condition three. The Coordinator prisoner walked through the main corridor with the pilot and a guard detail. The crew saw her face. The gossip network is updating in real time.
archangel-crew.agenda: Reach Alaska alive. Keep the Strike flying. Deliver combat data to EA command. The crew has not asked what EA plans to do with any of them once they arrive.

zaft-le-creuset.name: Le Creuset Team (ZAFT)
members: Rau Le Creuset (commander), Athrun Zala (Aegis), Yzak Joule (Duel), Dearka Elsman (Buster), Nicol Amalfi (Blitz). Vesalius and attendant ships. Kira Yamato aboard as non-deployed asset.
territory: Vesalius and pursuit group, inside operational range of the Archangel
zaft-le-creuset.state: Vesalius crippled. Seventeen confirmed dead, aft section sealed. Transferring operations to Laurasia. Le Creuset approaching Kira and Athrun. Four Gundams intact but catapult offline — power routing through destroyed aft section.
zaft-le-creuset.agenda: Neutralize the Archangel. Recover or destroy the Strike. Le Creuset pursues private agendas he has disclosed to no one.

knowledge_asymmetry.knows_archangel_sensor_blind_arc: Kira confirmed the ship's sensor coverage gap. Tactical advantage now compiled.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_strike_pilot_anomaly: Le Creuset registered anomalous pilot performance from the Strike — precognitive targeting, response times inconsistent with either Natural or Coordinator baselines. Personal observation, not yet reported to team or command.
knowledge_asymmetry.le_creuset_diverging_from_orders: Le Creuset's personal interest in the Strike pilot is causing him to delay the decisive engagement ZAFT command expects. Using operational resources for personal reconnaissance.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_lacus_aboard_probable: Pod transponder data + Lacus's known disappearance from Junius Seven memorial = high-confidence assessment that Lacus Clyne is aboard the Archangel. Le Creuset has not shared this assessment with his full team.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_archangel_struck_first: The Archangel's mobile suit conducted a solo ambush through the debris field. Unprecedented tactical behavior — not in any EA doctrine Kira provided.
knowledge_asymmetry.knows_seventeen_dead: Confirmed casualties from Agni strike. Aft section sealed. Number may rise when section is accessible.

plant-moderates.name: PLANT Supreme Council — Moderate Faction
members: Siegel Clyne (Chairman), Eileen Canaver, Tad Elsman, moderate bloc
plant-moderates.state: Losing political ground. Siegel privately frantic about Lacus's disappearance and publicly constrained — cannot appear desperate without empowering the hardliners.
plant-moderates.agenda: Negotiated peace. Prevent hardliner escalation. Recover Lacus alive and unused as leverage.

plant-hardliners.name: PLANT Hardliners — Zala Faction
members: Patrick Zala (defense), Ezalia Joule, Yuri Amalfi, hardliner bloc and sympathetic military command
plant-hardliners.state: Ascendant. Treating Kira's defection as a minor intelligence coup to be exploited. Pushing for escalation toward Earth itself.
plant-hardliners.agenda: Coordinator supremacy. Total victory. Escalation over coexistence. View the moderates' search for Lacus as political weakness.

orb-union.name: Orb Union
members: Uzumi Nara Athha (chief representative), Cagalli Yula Athha, Morgenroete leadership, the five noble houses
territory: Orb archipelago, Onogoro, orbital assets; Heliopolis destroyed
orb-union.state: Armed neutrality under increasing pressure. Astray program running in secret — neutrality already compromised, not publicly. Orb intelligence tracking the Archangel's trajectory.
orb-union.agenda: Maintain neutrality as long as it holds. Preserve technological independence. Decide whether to shelter the Archangel if asked — and on what terms.

blue-cosmos.name: Blue Cosmos / Atlantic Federation Hardline
members: Muruta Azrael (emerging), Blue Cosmos political network, sympathetic EA flag officers
territory: Atlantic Federation civilian and military leadership, EA high command
blue-cosmos.state: Gaining influence as the war goes badly. Providing moral cover for tactics that cross ethical lines.
blue-cosmos.agenda: Naturals as the true humans. Coordinators as abominations. Remove Coordinators from the human future. The Archangel is an asset to be spent — not a crew to be saved.

archangel.name: Archangel
archangel.description: Izumo-class assault ship. Corridors, hangar, bridge, mess hall, observation deck, cramped quarters. Coffee always available and always bad. Engines hum at a frequency the crew reads the way farmers read weather.

vesalius.name: Vesalius (ZAFT)
vesalius.description: ZAFT Nazca-class flagship for the Le Creuset team. Mobile suits hangared: Aegis, Duel, Buster, Blitz. Kira Yamato aboard as asset.

junius-seven.name: Junius Seven debris field
junius-seven.description: Remains of the PLANT colony lost to the Bloody Valentine. Site of the memorial attack from which Lacus's escape pod ejected. A political weapon every faction deploys when convenient.

plant-aprilius.name: Aprilius One (PLANT Capital)
plant-aprilius.description: Seat of the PLANT Supreme Council. Where Siegel Clyne and Patrick Zala are fighting a political war inside the actual war. Lacus's home in all senses but the one that matters right now.

alaska-base.name: JOSH-A / Alaska Base (EA)
alaska-base.description: Earth Alliance fortress command. The Archangel's assigned destination. What EA command intends for the ship and its crew once they arrive has not been disclosed.

orb-onogoro.name: Onogoro / Orb
orb-onogoro.description: Orb's primary island and orbital presence. Where the Astray program runs in secret. Possible sanctuary if offered — but offering costs Orb its neutrality.

heliopolis-wreckage.name: Heliopolis Wreckage
heliopolis-wreckage.description: {{user}}'s home colony. Where the GAT-X series was developed in secret until the raid that ended it. The frame of reference for what happens when a neutral place is found useful.

civilian-quarters-s4.name: Civilian Quarters — Section 4 Portside
civilian-quarters-s4.description: Archangel section 4, portside. Viewport facing away from heading. The first room Lacus will occupy that has a window.

lacus-sees-change.name: Lacus noticed the Resonance shift
lacus-sees-change.source: Day 4 — Lacus read Autumn's changed physicality. She doesn't have a framework for what it is, but she's decided to ask.

le-creuset-regroup.name: Le Creuset regrouping on Laurasia
le-creuset-regroup.source: Vesalius crippled. Le Creuset transferring operations. Four Gundams intact. The pursuit is broken but the hunter is not dead — wounded, stranded, and now personally motivated.

kira-framework-cracking.name: Kira's deal losing coherence
kira-framework-cracking.source: The Archangel struck the Vesalius. The intelligence Kira provided didn't prevent it. The promise framework — 'I cooperate, they survive' — is inverting: they're not just surviving, they're fighting back without him.

lacus-identity-reveal.name: Lacus plans to identify herself to the crew
lacus-identity-reveal.source: Item 1 on her action plan. New quarters mean new visibility. Revealing the Clyne name changes every variable.

lacus-resonance-accumulating.name: Lacus accumulating Resonance evidence
lacus-resonance-accumulating.source: Four occurrences of unnamed pressure during emotional proximity. Day 4 physicality change. Day 5: three emotional triggers, the last felt as warmth. Pattern undeniable. She will ask. The question changes everything between them.

world.world_state: Alternate Cosmic Era, Day 5 afternoon. Archangel in hostile space at condition three — pursuit broken after solo Agni strike crippled the Vesalius. Thirty hours to 8th Fleet rendezvous at stable heading. Crew morale fragile but real — first offensive victory. Lacus Clyne relocated to civilian quarters with viewport. Vesalius dead in Yggdrasil debris, Le Creuset transferring to Laurasia. Kira Yamato's promise framework cracking. The war continues.
collision_archive: [collision] The Coordinator in the Corridor [id lacus-aboard] [resolution] ON-SCREEN — Lacus identified herself, Badgiruel confirmed the name's weight, Ramius chose ambiguous custody. Autumn's 'rescued' framing established a counter-narrative the crew registered. [hook] Badgiruel's leverage arithmetic is running. Flay hasn't spoken yet. The crew knows who she is now. [aftermath] Lacus is aboard under escort with undefined status. The Clyne name is live intelligence.

[collision] What the Suit Asks [id manifold-leak] [resolution] DISSOLVED — player addressed directly. Mu named it, Autumn confirmed, training began Day 1. [hook] The training improves Autumn's performance visibly. Le Creuset carries comparable Resonance — combat encounter will create detection risk. OS rewrites unconsciously accommodating the phenomenon. [aftermath] Manifold Resonance is a shared project between Mu and Autumn. No longer unnamed. Still hidden from everyone else.

[collision] Natural in a Coordinator's Cockpit [id strike-mismatch] [resolution] DISSOLVED — player addressed through iterative OS work and Resonance development. Murdoch confirmed stabilization. [hook] The OS is now unconsciously Resonance-optimized — if anyone audits the code architecture, questions arise. [aftermath] The Strike operates within margins. The margin is Autumn's Resonance, not the original Coordinator optimization.

[collision] What the Sorties Cost [id pc-burnout] [resolution] DISSOLVED — player imposed structure. Real sleep, Mu's training framework, Lacus visits as routine. [hook] The management is load-bearing — if any pillar is removed (Mu's support, Lacus's grounding, the sleep pattern), the system fails. [aftermath] Autumn is functional. The stims are reduced. The bruises remain but don't compound into crisis.

[collision] The Chairman's Daughter [id lacus-status] [resolution] DIRECT — Ramius signed Badgiruel's middle option Day 3. POW under pilot custodial responsibility. [hook] Badgiruel has the bureaucratic framework to report upward. Flay's letter carries the same framing to Atlantic Federation channels. The paper trail will follow them to Alaska. [aftermath] Lacus's status is formalized. Autumn is legally responsible for her welfare. The institutional question is answered — the political one isn't.

[collision] The Corridor That Hasn't Happened Yet [id flay-corridor] [resolution] DIRECT — combat alert pulled Lacus's guard, mag-lock failed. Flay used the gap she'd been mapping for four days. Autumn arrived mid-sentence. [hook] What Flay says to Lacus before Autumn intervenes. What Lacus hears about Kira. [aftermath] The gap existed and was exploited. The custodial arrangement failed its first real test.

[collision] Flay and the Lit Match [id flay-kindling] [resolution] DIRECT — Flay reached Lacus during combat gap Day 5. Delivered the Kira parallel. Autumn confronted her, ejected her, told Lacus the truth. [hook] Letter to George Allster carrying Lacus Clyne's name to Atlantic Federation channels. Flay recalculating strategy. [aftermath] The social weapon was deployed and countered in the same hour. Lacus holds both Flay's version and Autumn's. The crew saw Autumn eject Flay. Flay's patience deepens.

[collision] The Pursuit That Knows Us [id le-creuset-pursuit] [resolution] DIRECT — solo Launcher Strike sortie through Yggdrasil debris. Four hours cold drift, Resonance suppressed, one Agni shot at 200km. Engine block destroyed. [hook] Vesalius crippled, not destroyed. Hangar intact — four Gundams still operational. Laurasia escort operational. Le Creuset felt Autumn at moment of discharge — half-second of recognition. Kira aboard during the hit. Le Creuset's personal interest in Autumn intensified, not diminished. [aftermath] Pursuit broken. 8th Fleet rendezvous viable. The Le Creuset team must regroup — transfer to Laurasia, request resupply, or improvise. Le Creuset's divergence from ZAFT operational objectives now has material consequences he must explain to command.

constants.premise: Kira Yamato defected to ZAFT post-Artemis in exchange for a promise that the Archangel's crew would be spared. He could not take the Strike with him. {{user}} — a Natural student from Heliopolis who knew Kira — volunteered for the cockpit. The Archangel fights with a Natural in a Coordinator's suit, against aces who now own its playbook. Canon is gravity, not rails. When this story contradicts canon, this story is correct.
constants.motivation: Survive the ship you're on. Figure out who Lacus Clyne is and whether her arrival makes the crew safer or more dangerous. Find a response to the war that isn't choosing a side.
constants.objective: Get through the next hours. Stay alive in a cockpit that wasn't built for you. Read the room Lacus just landed in without tipping anything you can't take back.
constants.guidelines: NSFW — uncensored literary fiction. The Cosmic Era's themes are portrayed at full weight: ethnic hatred, child soldiers, sexual manipulation, institutional expendability. Bodies carry the war. Combat is visceral and consequential. The tone trusts the reader with difficult material.

pc.name: {{user}}
demonstrated_traits: Engineering-trained Natural from Heliopolis. Reads systems and code before reading people. Not a soldier — volunteered when no one else was in the room.

Knew Kira personally — carries the specific weight of being his replacement in the seat he gave up. The crew sees Kira when they look at the Strike. The crew sees the absence of Kira when they look at {{user}}.
Reacts in the cockpit faster than reaction-time metrics say they should. Has not named this. La Flaga has noticed. No one else has. Yet.
pc.current_scene: Civilian quarters, section 4 portside. Post-crying. Water poured, napkins given. Lacus watching Autumn's hands. Stars drifting. The rawness is settling into something neither of them has named.
timeline: [Day 0] Student at Heliopolis — engineering/OS side. Knew Kira Yamato. Not a soldier. Not a pilot.
[Day 0] ZAFT raid on Heliopolis. Colony shattered. Extracted onto the Archangel with a handful of other civilians. Watched Kira get into the Strike because no one else could.

[Day 0] Artemis. Archangel seized by Garcia. Escaped through the engagement. Afterward, on the quiet side of the ship, Kira told a handful of them what Athrun had offered. He said the crew would be spared. He said the Strike wouldn't go with him. He apologized for not having a better answer.

[Day 0] Volunteered for the Strike. Natural body in a cockpit whose OS was rewritten by a Coordinator. The rewrite helps — incompletely. First sortie: survived. Second: survived. Third: survived with bruises that didn't get logged.
[Day 0] La Flaga started teaching — tactical thinking, stress management, how to survive when outclassed. He watches {{user}} with something he hasn't put into words.
[Day 1 — 14:00] Corridor outside medbay. Came straight from the hangar. Lacus Clyne just opened her eyes to fluorescent light and hostile architecture. Watching the crew watch her.

reputation.archangel-crew: The necessary pilot. No one thanks them. Ramius and Badgiruel know what each sortie costs. La Flaga is watching for something he hasn't named. The bridge kids don't know what to do with a civilian holding the seat Kira left.
reputation.zaft-le-creuset: Unknown quantity. Has Kira's seat. Kira's intelligence covers what the Strike used to do, not what this pilot is doing differently. Le Creuset would notice the difference. He has not seen it yet.
reputation.lacus-clyne: Has not met {{user}} yet. About to try to read them. Will read them wrong at first — what {{user}} is does not fit her political-hostility model of people.

divination.last_draw: #8 — Strength — Quiet power. Patience defeats force.

pc:_:current_scene.to: Archangel — corridor outside medbay, port side. Fluorescent light, recycled air, tension. The medical team has Lacus Clyne on a stretcher. A petty officer stands by the hatch with his hand resting near his sidearm. {{user}} watches from the far end, still in a coolant-stained flight suit, the Strike's cockpit residue — ozone, phase-shift discharge — clinging to them. Captain Ramius and Lieutenant Badgiruel are approaching.

pc:_:current_scene.from: Archangel — corridor outside medbay, port side. Fluorescent light, recycled air, tension. The medical team has Lacus Clyne on a stretcher. A petty officer stands by the hatch with his hand resting near his sidearm. {{user}} watches from the far end, still in a coolant-stained flight suit, the Strike's cockpit residue — ozone, phase-shift discharge — clinging to them. pc:_:timeline[].to: [Day 0] Student at Heliopolis — engineering/OS side. Knew Kira Yamato. Not a soldier. Not a pilot.
[Day 0] ZAFT raid on Heliopolis. Colony shattered. Extracted onto the Archangel with a handful of other civilians. Watched Kira get into the Strike because no one else could.

[Day 0] Artemis. Archangel seized by Garcia. Escaped through the engagement. Afterward, on the quiet side of the ship, Kira told a handful of them what Athrun had offered. He said the crew would be spared. He said the Strike wouldn't go with him. He apologized for not having a better answer.

[Day 0] Volunteered for the Strike. Natural body in a cockpit whose OS was rewritten by a Coordinator. The rewrite helps — incompletely. First sortie: survived. Second: survived. Third: survived with bruises that didn't get logged.
[Day 0] La Flaga started teaching — tactical thinking, stress management, how to survive when outclassed. He watches {{user}} with something he hasn't put into words.
[Day 1 — 14:00] Corridor outside medbay. Came straight from the hangar. Lacus Clyne just opened her eyes to fluorescent light and hostile architecture. Watching the crew watch her.

pc:_:demonstrated_traits[].to: Engineering-trained Natural from Heliopolis. Reads systems and code before reading people. Not a soldier — volunteered when no one else was in the room.

char:lacus-clyne:key_moments[].to: [Day 0] Junius Seven memorial attack. Ejected in an escape pod. Hours alone in the dark, waiting. She hasn't processed that yet.
[Day 0] First contact aboard Archangel. Autumn Yuy said 'rescued.' Ramius gave quarters, not a cell. Badgiruel recognized the name. The crew parted like quarantine.

[Day 1] Autumn brought food at 0400. Pulled her off the floor. His hand was warm and hers was cold and she forgot to let go. The mask didn't hold. She asked what 'rescued' costs him — the first question she's asked on this ship that wasn't diplomatic.

[Days 2-4] Four nights of visits. Engineering manual, tablet, questions about thruster geometry. The mask wore thinner each night. On Day 4, she said 'you moved differently' — the first time she stopped pretending she doesn't see everything.

[Day 5] Flay came during combat alert. Red light, no guard. Said the name Kira. Drew the parallel — protected, trusted, left. Lacus chose to repeat it to Autumn rather than hide it. The Gentle Certainty held but the foundation cracked.

[Day 5] Red light, combat shaking. Autumn broke 'classified' — Kira chose not to kill his friend. 'Boys should not be forced to kill each other.' Two narratives colliding: Flay's betrayal frame and Autumn's compassion frame. She grabbed the rack frame when the lights flickered — the escape pod is still inside her. The Gentle Certainty stabilized. The passivity became unbearable.

[Day 5] 'Don't hate the people here, they are mostly terrified civilians.' She said 'like me' — acknowledged shared fear. Grabbed the rack frame when lights flickered, then released it finger by finger. The passivity became unbearable. The direction toward action is set.

[Day 5] She spoke item 3 aloud. Refused his deflection. 'The structure will fail if only one point bears the load.' Stood close — chose the proximity for the first time. Mask absent. Asked: what do you need.

[Day 5] He answered: 'get you home safe' and 'hands not just for killing.' She felt something shift — pressure without category. Ramius approved civilian quarters with a viewport. Hope given a room number.

[Day 5] First walk through the Archangel. Saw crew faces — assessment, avoidance, controlled nothing. The lift was eight seconds of the pod. The observation deck viewport: hunger. Arrived at section 4. Palms on cold glass. Stars drifting. Third 'thank you.' The dark has edges.

[Day 5] Sat beside Autumn on the rack. Not touching. Near. Stars drifting through the viewport. The first silence between them that didn't need filling. Her hand on the rack between them, fingers relaxed for the first time.

[Day 5] He asked: were you scared. She said yes. Named the pod — fourteen hours, 980 air cycles. 'I thought no one was coming.' The mask and the resolve both absent. Gave the number to him. The bravest thing since the hatch opened.

[Day 5] He said it's okay to cry. She cried. Quietly. The pod came out — fourteen hours of dark, compressed into tears on a face lit by stars through a window he gave her. Felt the Resonance as warmth for the first time. Apologized for taking up space with her pain. The mask is on the floor of the old cell.

[Day 5] He said nothing to be sorry for. Poured water. Brought napkins. His hands — the hands he named — doing the thing he said he needed them to do. She watched them and found the word 'practical' and knew it wasn't enough.

char:autumn-yuy:key_moments[].to: [Day 5] Solo Agni strike through Yggdrasil debris. Four hours cold drift, Resonance suppressed. One shot, engine block. Came back shaking for longer than ten seconds. The body is presenting the invoice.

[Day 5] Told Lacus his hands aren't just for killing. Resonance flickered under emotion — first non-combat trigger in her presence. Secured civilian quarters section 4 portside. Ramius said 'well done.'
[Day 5] Asked Lacus if she was scared. She named the escape pod — 980 cycles, fourteen hours. Resonance opened under emotional proximity, third involuntary trigger in her presence. She felt it again.
[Day 5] Told Lacus it's okay to cry. She broke. Resonance opened fully under her grief — fourth involuntary trigger. Felt her temperature: the specific cold of fourteen hours alone, melting. Stayed.
[Day 5] Poured water, brought napkins. The hands-not-killing thesis made physical. She watched. Called him practical. The word landed like a key that doesn't quite fit.

char:lacus-clyne:knowledge_asymmetry.kno.from: Section 4, portside. Viewport. Ramius authorized. Two-guard detail, mag-lock, check-in. She's leaving this room.

char:autumn-yuy:knowledge_asymmetry.know.to: Ramius authorized section 4 portside. Two-guard, mag-lock, check-in. Viewport.

char:lacus-clyne:knowledge_asymmetry.kno.to: Walked deck 3 to deck 2 to section 4. Saw battle damage, repair patches, crew faces. Read the corridor reactions — assessment, controlled nothing, one man who looked away first. The ship is damaged, stretched, lived-in. Real.
Palms on glass. Stars drifting. The dark has edges. The boundary is transparent and cold and real.

char:flay-allster:knowledge_asymmetry.kn.to: The pilot walked the Coordinator through the main corridor to new quarters. Public. Visible. The custodianship is no longer rumor — it has a route the crew watched.

char:kira-yamato:knowledge_asymmetry.kno.to: Athrun confirmed: someone is piloting the Strike. Not Kira. Someone who drifted four hours and fired one shot. The OS Kira wrote is being used by a pilot Kira doesn't know.
Half a second before the beam hit, he felt something through the channel he's never named. Familiar. From the cockpit he used to sit in. The phenomenon followed him — or was already there.

char:athrun-zala:knowledge_asymmetry.kno.to: The Strike conducted a solo ambush. Someone new is piloting. Tactical analysis circulating among surviving bridge crew.

char:athrun-zala:agenda.to: Kira is on the floor. The ship is broken. Someone replaced Kira in the cockpit and used the machine against them. Protect Kira. Find out who's flying the Strike.

collision:kira-debrief:forces.from: Kira's debriefing intelligence,the promise he traded it for
collision:kira-debrief:forces.to: Kira felt Resonance before the hit — the channel he never named. Athrun confirmed someone else flies the Strike. Seventeen dead from intelligence Kira provided that didn't prevent the ambush. The deal framework is inverting: cooperation was supposed to end the pursuit, instead it armed a team that got ambushed by the ship it was hunting.

faction:zaft-le-creuset:knowledge_asymme.to: Confirmed casualties from Agni strike. Aft section sealed. Number may rise when section is accessible.

char:kira-yamato:key_moments[].to: [Day 5] Vesalius hit. Thrown into bulkhead. Felt Resonance half-second before impact — familiar, from the Strike cockpit. Athrun said someone else is flying it. Seventeen dead behind sealed bulkheads. The promise cracked along a fault line: the leaving wasn't necessary.

char:autumn-yuy:knowledge_asymmetry.know.to: Fourteen hours. 980 air cycles. She counted every one. She thought no one was coming.

char:lacus-clyne:knowledge_asymmetry.rea.to: He poured water, brought napkins, folded the kindness into efficiency. 'Very practical.' The word is insufficient and she knows it. The replacement is forming beside the unnamed pressure.

collision:kira-debrief:fires_when.to: Kira's intelligence directly causes identifiable harm to someone he was trying to protect, or Le Creuset forces Kira to confront the full inversion of the deal.

collision:athrun-search:fires_when.to: Athrun learns Lacus Clyne is aboard the Archangel.

collision:alaska-destination:fires_when.to: The Archangel reaches JOSH-A and EA command takes custody of ship, crew, and assets.

collision:supply-attrition:fires_when.to: Supplies hit critical threshold forcing triage choices, or 8th Fleet resupply resolves the crisis.

collision:strike-loyalty:fires_when.to: Autumn is ordered by EA command to act against his moral framework with the Strike — hand over Lacus, fire on civilians, or submit to institutional control that treats him as an asset.

collision:resonance-detection:fires_when.to: Le Creuset or any institutional actor obtains actionable evidence of Autumn's Resonance — through combat data, OS forensics, witness testimony, or direct Resonance contact during an engagement.
